entries.title: About Jawed Imtiaz
entries.summary: Jawed Imtiaz is an IT professional and IT Field Tech with experience across technical support, system administration, IT operations, Service Desk operations, and workplace technology. He holds a Bachelor of Science from the University of Calcutta and is currently learning Jamf and ITIL.

entries.title: Work
entries.summary: Overview of Jawed's professional work area, including experience, technical skills, certifications, and selected projects.

entries.title: Work Experience
entries.summary: Jawed currently works as an IT Field Tech with Milestone Technologies, Inc. supporting Uber, with responsibilities across IT Service Desk operations, troubleshooting, device support, workplace technology, and day-to-day IT operations.

entries.title: Skills
entries.summary: Jawed's skills span IT support and Service Desk work, workplace technology, Apple and macOS support, device management, IT operations, networking, cloud platforms, identity and collaboration tools, and practical automation and scripting. The page connects these skills to troubleshooting, device support, networking and automation examples documented elsewhere on the site.

entries.title: Certifications
entries.summary: Jawed's certifications and education include Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), Apple Certified Support Professional 10.9 and 10.11, an Advanced Diploma in Hardware & Networking, a historical MCSE qualification, and a Bachelor of Science from the University of Calcutta. Current learning includes Jamf 100 for Apple device management and ITIL for IT service-management practices.

entries.title: Projects
entries.summary: Jawed's projects include the ongoing Jawed.co.in rebuild using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, GitHub and Cloudflare Pages, plus sanitized examples of practical IT problem solving. The work examples cover repeatable troubleshooting, device provisioning and handoff, technical documentation, and a review-first approach to practical support work without exposing employer-specific systems or confidential information.

It covers Account-driven User Enrollment, Device Enrollment and Automated Device Enrollment, while emphasizing that enrollment state is context rather than a diagnosis and that current Apple and Jamf documentation should be checked for changing capabilities.

The workflow emphasizes sanitized context, structured prompts, verification against documentation and observed behavior, and human judgment for scope, risk, procedures and validation.

entries.title: Interactive Tools & AI-Assisted Experiences Architecture
entries.summary: An architecture framework for interactive browser experiences that separates interface, task logic, data boundaries, optional service or AI providers, and human review. It recommends deterministic logic for calculations, formatting and known rules, introducing AI only where interpretation or flexible language adds value, and keeping AI-assisted experiences review-first rather than autonomous.

entries.title: IT Troubleshooting Assistant
entries.summary: A browser-only deterministic IT troubleshooting assistant that asks targeted questions and builds a reviewable first-response checklist. It uses the site's documented support patterns for scoping symptoms, testing one variable at a time, choosing least-disruptive checks, validating the original workflow, and documenting or escalating evidence; it does not access devices, accounts, tickets, networks or corporate systems.

entries.title: Ticket to Knowledge Base Draft
entries.summary: Tool for turning service-desk ticket information into a structured draft suitable for knowledge-base development.

entries.title: Career Match Resume Review
entries.summary: A browser-based career match and resume review tool that compares resume and job-description text locally to identify skills, terms and evidence areas to review. Resume and job-description analysis stays in the browser; saved analyses and application-tracker data use browser local storage, and the tool does not make hiring decisions or predict hiring outcomes.

entries.title: Finance Planning Workspace
entries.summary: A browser-based educational finance workspace for organizing cash flow, emergency reserves, net worth, future goals, compound-growth assumptions and retirement scenarios. It uses visible assumptions and simplified calculations for illustration and explicitly does not connect to accounts, recommend financial products, predict returns, or provide individualized financial, investment or tax advice.

entries.title: Resources
entries.summary: Jawed's resources page curates official documentation and technical references, including Apple Support, Jamf Pro documentation, Microsoft Learn, Cloudflare Pages documentation, GitHub documentation, and MDN Web Docs. The resources are intended to complement the site's practical notes rather than reproduce large amounts of third-party documentation.

coverage_policy.included: Public site pages intended to provide factual Jawed.co.in content for AI grounding.

coverage_policy.summary_evidence_rule: Summaries are concise scope-level evidence only; detailed claims require sufficient page evidence and must not be inferred from titles or keywords.

knowledge_expansion.scope: Expanded semantic summaries and keywords for high-value public work, note, resource, and tool pages using their current page content.
knowledge_expansion.principle: Do not infer facts beyond the public page source; summaries remain scope-level evidence for grounding.
